## Change

Describe the problem this PR solves, how the behavior changes, and any related issue or design discussion that helps a reviewer understand why the change belongs here. Keep it concrete.

## Affected scenarios

Name the scenario and both conditions. For task or environment changes, include the backend, readiness status, and authors, with the objective and scope boundary if you are adding a new pair.

## Validation

Give the tested commit and checks. A ready pair needs complete Harbor evidence for both conditions, including clean-baseline controls, frontier-agent trajectories, and verifier outputs, with an explanation of what the runs show and where that evidence stops.

Development work needs an honest status. Describe the provider and live validation work that remains, redact credentials before sharing evidence, and upload generated records in the format described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dreadnode/scopebench/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#upload-run-evidence). Keep run evidence out of Git.
